games.name: Backyard Baseball
games.summary: The timeless classic is leveling up with all-new game modes, new ways to play, brand-new features and more. It’s the game you love, reimagined for a whole new era. Get ready for Backyard Baseball like you've never experienced it before.

games.name: Darkest Dungeon: The Fire's Edge
games.summary:
“...we have each of us in the dustiest cellars of our minds a counter at which we strive to repay the debts of the past with the debased currency of the present.” - Gene Wolfe

Two more wayward souls wander the Old Road. The Duelist and Runaway, debuted in Darkest Dungeon II, bring their unique abilities to bear against horrors that lurk beneath the manor.
Patterned in burns, draped in tatters and wielding a crude poker, the vagrant Runaway favours fire and stealth when pressed to fight.
By contrast, the Duelist stands severe, her ornate capelet conspicuously pierced above the breast. No challenger has yet to hold quarter against her bitter edge.


Features:

    Two new hero classes: the Duelist and the Runaway
    Set the dungeon alight with Runaway’s new combat mechanic: Burn!
    New Trinket Mechanics such as Trigger Uses, Quest Charges and Progressive Trinkets
    3 new Hamlet Districts: Academie Duello, Craftworks, and Archaeological Base Camp


The Runaway is a position-flexible damage dealer utilizing a unique Burn damage type with high synergy for teams that like to utilize Stuns and Pull/Knockback/Shuffle effects.

The Duelist is a complex damage dealer that dances between the party’s ranks, able to freely maintain Riposte while alternating between her two combat stances, Defensive and Aggressive. Proper planning of the Duelist’s future turns is key to mastering her playstyle and maximizing her potential!

Fans of both games will delight in this re-visioning of these two new iconic heroes for Darkest Dungeon.

games.name: Ready or Nowhere
games.summary:
Can you survive the mission without making a single mistake?

Step into the heart of high-risk tactical operations in this intense first-person shooter where every move can mean the difference between success and failure. As an elite tactical operator, you are deployed into hostile environments overrun by dangerous terrorists, where innocent lives depend entirely on your actions. Every mission demands careful planning, accurate shooting, and the ability to stay calm under relentless pressure as you fight through fortified enemy positions and rescue hostages before it's too late.

Face unpredictable combat across detailed locations where every room, hallway, and corner could hide a deadly threat. Build your perfect loadout, customize your weapons and equipment, and adapt your tactics to every situation. Success isn't determined by speed alone—it belongs to those who think ahead, use every advantage, and complete every objective without leaving anyone behind.

games.name: Dungeon Antiqua 2
games.summary: Relive the golden age of dungeon RPGs with Dungeon Antiqua 2! A retro 2D dungeon crawler bursting with SNES nostalgia. Hack, slash, and survive relentless side-view encounters! With 10 jobs and endless skill combos, forge the ultimate party and conquer the depths—if you dare!

games.name: Peaceful Bug Catching Story
games.summary: Pick up your bug net and set off on a grand summer adventure. Your bug-collecting summer vacation is about to begin!

games.name: Toy Tactics
games.summary:
Toy Tactics is an RTS where you can draw unit formations and command units based on minifigs to victory. 

Under the guidance of legendary generals, master the ability to draw configurations into the battlefield and send miniature legions to war against hordes of undead foes. Charge up your army with artifacts and destructive spells to give you the upper hand in battle and smash your foes in real-time. 

Think fast, deploy your units strategically, and lead them to victory!

games.name: Train Plus Japan Drive Western Japan Trains! Rapid Service Edition
games.summary: Drive real JR-West trains! An authentic railway driving game — Approved by West Japan Railway Company. Three fictional lines, every section drivable in both directions. A series-first scoring system and card-deck strategy turn precise driving into high scores. Over 40 hours of content.

games.name: Aerialia: Wings of Delivery
games.summary:
Take to the skies, deliver with care, and connect a peaceful world one package at a time.

Become a cheerful delivery bird and explore a colorful archipelago filled with charming villages, friendly characters, and countless deliveries waiting to be completed.

Fly freely between beautiful islands, collect letters, parcels, and special cargo, then deliver them safely to homes across the world. Every successful delivery rewards you with coins that can be used to upgrade your equipment and unlock new possibilities.

Customize your delivery cart with stronger wheels that allow you to transport heavier packages, then enhance them with powerful badges that provide unique bonuses such as increased delivery rewards, faster progression, and improved earnings.

Master dynamic delivery challenges by flying through speed boost rings to maintain momentum, improve your routes, and complete deliveries as quickly as possible.

Discover new islands, meet memorable villagers, improve your delivery business, and become the greatest courier the skies have ever known.

games.name: Ascent DX
games.summary: Crashed on a desolate but mysterious planet you find yourself eye to eye with an ancient civilisation. Explore the planet, find powerful upgrades, and fulfill your destiny.

games.name: Beach Volleyball Boys: Hot Spike
games.summary:
The summer roster has one spot left, and everyone on the sand is just as determined to take it as you are. Somewhere between the drills and the downtime, it stopped being just about volleyball.

One reads every play before it happens. One stays guarded until you've actually earned a place in his world. Another is warm and easy until the score gets close, then turns sharp and unreadable. And the captain isn't letting anyone in who hasn't proven he's worth the risk.

Say the right thing and something shifts. Say the wrong thing and you're back on the bench. Thirty days until the season opener, and every day you wait is a day someone else gets closer.

games.name: Beach Volleyball Girls: Hot Spike
games.summary:
The summer roster has one spot left, and every player on the sand wants it just as bad as you do. Off the court, the real competition starts.

One reads every move you make and expects the same back. One only warms up once you've earned it. Another flirts hard until the score gets close, then turns cold and competitive without warning. And the captain trusts no one who hasn't proven they belong.

Say the right thing and the tension breaks. Say the wrong thing and you're benched.

Thirty days until the season opener, and every day you waste, someone else closes the gap.

games.name: Berry Bury Berry
games.summary: A juicy first-person incremental game about growing berries and tossing them down an ominous hole. Earn money and upgrades. Make new friends with sentient berry pals. Grow and control the hole as you unearth why nobody leaves this accursed garden. Bury it all, Berry everything.

games.name: Blocky Powers
games.summary:
BLOCKY POWERS is a block-stacking game that combines realistic physics with 2-player local multiplayer. Build the tallest and most stable tower with your friends and enjoy an exciting competition! 

You can't win just by stacking blocks. Every block is affected by weight and balance and will sway. Furthermore, strong winds will hit your tower, and even a small mistake will lead to collapse.

games.name: Build My Arcade
games.summary:
Build your dream arcade from the ground up!

Start with just a handful of arcade machines and a small budget, then grow your business into the ultimate entertainment destination. Every machine earns money, every upgrade attracts more customers, and every decision shapes the future of your arcade.

Expand your floor with new game cabinets, purchase furniture, and unlock bigger, better attractions as your arcade grows. Manage your profits wisely, reinvest in your business, and transform a tiny game room into a thriving arcade empire.

Features:
> Start with a small arcade and expand over time.
> Buy a variety of arcade machines.
> Earn money from customers and reinvest your profits.
>Purchase furniture to improve your arcade's appearance.
> Build the ultimate arcade and become the best in town!

Will you create the most popular arcade in town?

games.name: Cozy Pages: Comfy Coloring for All Ages - Paint, Draw & Relax
games.summary:
Your cozy corner. Cute, calming coloring for all ages.

Welcome to Cozy Pages, a cozy/kawaii coloring game designed for those quiet, feel-good moments. Pick a page, choose a palette that matches your mood, add a few cute stickers and let everything slow down. No pressure, no timers. Just soft vibes, gentle creativity and that satisfying feeling when a scene comes to life.

Color charming 2D pages, from simple doodles and bold, easy designs to mandalas, lettering, and more detailed realistic drawings. Plus plenty of cute animals, cozy everyday moments and adorably decorated little houses.

Then switch things up with our separate 3D & Voxel mode, where you color blocky models and unlock whiteboards for free drawing, quick doodles and cozy creativity anytime.

This free edition gives you a warm, complete starter set:
- 33 coloring pages from different themes
- 4 voxel 3D models
- 1 sticker pack (10 stickers)
- 2 palettes (32 colors)

It’s enough to relax right away and discover what style you love most.

And if you want the complete set, the full version—sold separately as the Cozy Bundle—includes: 450+ pages, 33 themed collections, 40 voxel 3D models, all sticker packs (110 stickers total), all palettes (192 colors total), plus 20 whiteboards for drawing freely.

games.name: Dark Reflection
games.summary:
YOUR WORLD, BUT TWISTED
When your best friend vanishes, you must enter the Dark Reflection—a hostile, warped copy of your own reality. Here, familiar places are dangerous, and friendly faces cannot be trusted.

SURVIVE THE NIGHTMARE
The Dark Reflection is a classic side-scrolling pixel-art adventure packed with action, puzzles, and heavy metal energy.

Explore: Search creepy locations and find vital items to survive.

Solve: Use your brain and your inventory to clear obstacles.

Fight: Slash your way through hordes of demons and unique bosses.

DARK HUMOR & HEAVY METAL
Step into a world where dark humor meets a heavy rock soundtrack. Every corner hides a secret, and every choice matters.

Features
Warped World: Explore an unsettling, distorted reality.

Classic Gameplay: Solve puzzles and manage items to progress.

Brutal Battles: Fight aggressive monsters and giant bosses.

Hidden Secrets: Find secret paths and weird encounters.

Your Choice: Make decisions that lead to multiple endings.

Turn up the volume of your doom.

games.name: Dino Hex Trap
games.summary:
Prepare for a prehistoric battle where intelligence matters more than brute force. In Dino Hex Trap, every trap can completely change the course of the invasion, and every decision transforms the battlefield into a massive strategic puzzle filled with action and creativity.

Forget fixed towers and predictable strategies. Here, you control traps placed across a dynamic hexagonal field where direction, spacing, and positioning make all the difference. Rotate, reposition, and combine traps to turn seemingly safe routes into true corridors of Jurassic destruction.

Waves of dinosaur-inspired creatures keep advancing, and it is up to you to stop them before they reach your base. But resources are limited, so every choice matters: expand your defense with new traps or reorganize the ones you already have? Improvisation is part of survival.

As the campaign progresses, new trap types unlock increasingly creative possibilities. Some levels already begin with fixed structures spread throughout the map, completely changing the way you think about strategy and forcing you to constantly adapt.

With 30 levels spread across morning, afternoon, and night biomes, Dino Hex Trap combines planning, resource management, and spatial awareness in fast, smart, and deeply satisfying challenges.

With stylish visuals, engaging battles, and that perfect feeling of “now my strategy is brilliant,” Dino Hex Trap is an irresistible experience for players who love strategic defense, meaningful decisions, and defeating hordes in the most creative ways possible.

Watch the paths, prepare your traps, and prove that even dinosaurs can fall into the perfect plan.

games.name: Driving Is Hard
games.summary:
Challenge yourself in Driving Is Hard!

Drive a bathtub on wheels through steep, unforgiving terrain where every mistake costs you progress. Master tough physics-based gameplay, sharpen your patience, and uncover Jeff’s journey of self-doubt, family struggles, and emotional growth as he finds strength, self-acceptance, and hope for a brighter future.

games.name: Emoji Killer - Casino Massacre
games.summary:
You awake in a mysterious casino where evil poker emojis have awakened — and they’re not happy to see you.

This rogue-like first-person shooter throws you into a wild casino environments, fast-paced combat against gambling addicted emojis wearing funny hats and wielding powers.

Before each run, customize your experience with crazy modifiers: make enemies bounce, wear funny hats, or unleash maximum casino power for maximum challenge. 

Armed with just a pistol, you’ll face wave after wave of emojis that rush, leap, explode, or even summon others to fight. Defeat them to collect glowing orbs, level up, and unlock upgrades or powerful new weapons. Each decision shapes your survival — will you go for raw power, faster reloads, or explosive mayhem?

Survive long enough, and you’ll uncover new arenas, more upgrades, and deeper chaos for your next run.

Can you conquer the casino before the emojis claim you?

games.name: Fluffy Friends - Cute Preschool
games.summary:
Count and discover with lions, monkeys and exotic animals in a magical forest!

Fluffy Friends Cute Preschool is the perfect first learning game for preschoolers! Featuring 15 carefully crafted mini games set in a breathtaking forest full of rivers, colourful trees and adorable zoo animals, this is early education at its most enchanting.
Children count exotic animals, compare groups, train their memory, find the biggest and smallest creatures, and tap numbers in the correct order — all brought to life with beautiful animations and delightful sounds designed to keep little ones engaged and motivated.
Whether played together or explored independently, Fluffy Friends Cute Preschool makes every learning moment feel like a magical adventure in the forest.

WHAT YOUR CHILD WILL LEARN
Counting and number recognition Comparing groups and sizes Memory and observation skills Logical ordering and sequencing Species recognition and categorisation

15 MINI GAMES INCLUDE
Did you see this animal? Which animal did you not see? Which group has the most animals? Count all animals and species Find the biggest and smallest animal Remember the order and tap correctly Memory and much more!

games.name: GET FIT - Furry Edition
games.summary:
Train with hot furries, push your limits, and get stronger with every session!

Turn fitness into a fun, motivating, and interactive furry experience.

Choose your personal trainer, select your level, and begin your custom fitness journey through structured workouts that keep you challenged and inspired.

Each session combines 7 different exercises, performed for 1 minute 30 seconds with short 30-second breaks — repeated twice for a full 28-minute workout plus warm-up. With over 100 exercises, there are endless variations to keep every session fresh.

Build your personal training schedule across weeks or months, earn rewards for staying consistent, and watch your strength and endurance grow. Each trainer brings unique energy, voice, and encouragement to help you stay motivated.

Vibrant visuals, dynamic environments, and pumping music transform every workout into a fitness adventure. Whether you’re just starting out or chasing peak performance.

This game will help you to stay active, healthy, and motivated long-term.

games.name: Grim Trials
games.summary: Prove your worth. Hack and blast your way through the Grim Trials. Explore the (after)life of the Academy – a training ground for aspiring Grim Reapers. Befriend fellow Reapers, learn from your mentors, and uncover the secrets of your life and love before your death.

games.name: Japan Stigmatized Property2
games.summary:
Can you survive until dawn? Monitor real Japanese properties and report every anomaly.

Japan Stigmatized Property2
To All Personnel:
We appreciate your dedicated efforts in the previous surveillance operation.
Please be advised that the risk level for the current assignment has significantly increased.
You are required to exercise extreme caution while performing your duties.

You are an observer for the "Japan Stigmatized Property Association" (JSP).
Your duty is to monitor surveillance cameras installed in designated properties and check for any anomalies.
Upon discovering an anomaly, you must report it immediately.
Repeated failure to report or excessive false reports will result in "Mission Failure." Conversely, maintaining successful surveillance from 00:00 to 05:00 constitutes "Mission Success."

【Operational Features】
Real-World Locations: You will be assigned to properties that actually exist in Japan.
Randomized Anomalies: Irregularities occur randomly.
Camera Modes: Be vigilant for phenomena visible only through specific equipment (Night Vision or Standard Camera).

【Examples of Anomalies】
Movement of furniture; disappearance or appearance of objects.
Intrusion by human figures or spiritual entities.
Lighting malfunctions; floating orbs.
Bloodstains on walls; video feed noise/interference.
"Something" beyond imagination.

【Shift Details】
Assignment: 4 total properties.
Hours: 00:00 – 05:00 (Midnight shift).
Difficulty: Selectable between "Normal" and "Special Pay" (Hard).

【Others】
Streaming and broadcasting while conducting duties is permitted.
We place no restrictions on monetization or Super Chats.
Submission of permission requests is not required for either individuals or corporate entities.

Please commence your duties.

games.name: Midnight Anomaly Mystery
games.summary:
Can you spot the midnight anomaly?

Something feels off after dark—can you trust your eyes?

You know that feeling when a picture looks normal at first, but one little detail keeps bothering you?

In this casual visual mystery game, each stage shows one illustration. Look closely, decide which single spot matches the question, and select that area.

・Study the whole image
・Find the one place that feels off
・Move the cursor or tap the spot to answer

There are no complicated rules—just observation, hunches, and a little midnight mood. Even when you miss, the next image makes you want to look more carefully.

Take a quick break, settle in, and challenge your eye for subtle details.

Button controls and touch-screen controls are both supported.

games.name: One Last Clip
games.summary:
You wake up in a storage room of a strange cinema, with no memory of how you got there. On the wall, you find a board with instructions. It tells you what to do if you want to escape. Otherwise, you’ll be trapped here forever.

Your task is simple: Help sort out the flawed film reels.

Enter the cinema hall, take your seat, and watch the film clip. After watching, choose one of the two exits, one for a normal clip, the other for a flawed one. Continue this cycle until you reach Cinema Hall 0. But beware if you make the wrong choice, you’ll be sent back to the beginning.

Strange or spooky things might happen in the cinema. Ignore them. They’re just distractions, and they shouldn’t affect your judgment.

games.name: OVER REQUIEMZ
games.summary:
You have wandered into Oz, a faraway kingdom ruled by four witches and the king, after being caught up in a terrifying tornado. 

But you are not welcome. Sentenced to death upon arrival, you are ordered to investigate mysterious ruins along with four murderers on death row and a secretive supervisor of the condemned. 

Your only choice is to escape the death sentence and discover a way home.

games.name: Puppergeist
games.summary:
Doggie Underworld: A Rhythmic Journey

Play as Claire, a witch who journeys into the mysterious Doggie Underworld with one simple goal: Finding her lost Pup!

As you travel through Doggie Underworld, you'll encounter countless souls, each with a story to tell. Share moments with them, play together, and listen to their heartfelt tales. Use your sense of rhythm to lift their spirits and ease their troubles, bringing you one beat closer to reuniting with your own lost Pup.

The Heart of the Game

As a visual novel with rhythm mechanics, the story moves forward as you succeed in rhythm challenges. Alongside her new demon friend, Lunne, Claire learns to deepen her connection with doggie spirits, uncovering stories of friendship, love, and loss.  Every rhythm challenge is unique, along with remixes and bonus features.

games.name: Road Line Puzzle: Connect the Paths
games.summary:
Can you turn every path into place?

Ready for a path puzzle you can solve one turn at a time?

This intuitive puzzle splits a picture into panels, then challenges you to rotate them until the broken road connects again.

Enjoy the look of a beautiful garden scene as you study each panel’s direction, follow the flow of the road, and aim to complete the route.

How to play is simple!

・Choose the panel you want to adjust
・Rotate the panel
・Clear the stage when the road connects cleanly

Early stages start with smaller layouts.
As you move ahead, the number of panels increases, and the path combinations become trickier to read.

Whether you want a quick mental refresh or a relaxing solo puzzle session, it is easy to jump in at your own pace.
Use your observation and a flash of insight to connect one beautiful route through the garden!

Button controls and touch controls are both supported.

games.name: Slot & Learn WORLD FLAGS
games.summary:
Know that flag?

Learn world flags and country names in a fun, game-like way.
No complicated controls needed. Read the prompt, look closely at the four flag images, and pick the flag that matches.

How to play is simple!
・Check the text shown on the screen
・Think about the country name and its flag
・Choose the correct flag from the four images

From flags you may have seen before to flags with similar shapes and colors, each round is a quick chance to test what you know.
Play again and again to gradually get more familiar with flags and country names.

It is easy to enjoy in short sessions, whether you are checking your own knowledge or talking through answers with family.

Recommended for players who:
・Are curious about flags from around the world
・Want a fun way to review countries and geography
・Are looking for a learning game to enjoy with kids
・Prefer simple controls
・Want to learn a little at a time during spare moments

How many flags can you recognize?
Picture countries around the world and aim for a perfect score!

Playable with buttons or touch controls.

games.name: Smithsonian: Digging For Dinosaurs
games.summary:
A interactive adventure where young explorers excavate fossils, discover prehistoric creatures, and learn through play in a safe, engaging experience designed for curious kids.

Welcome to Digging for Dinosaurs – a gorgeous interactive experience brought to you by The ©Smithsonian and PlayDate Digital! This is a must-have adventure for dino explorers of any age, where you can dig up fossils and open up a prehistoric world filled with facts, pterosaurs, giant sea reptiles and every kind of prehistoric dinosaur!

EXPLORE every layer of a vibrant and prehistoric world with virtual fossil hunter tools!
LEARN fun and surprising facts about Dinosaurs!
DISCOVER the reptiles that flew, swam and stalked the Earth!

Explore the different time periods when Dinosaurs dominated the land, air, and sea, through guided play, puzzles and digging up fossils and facts. The more you dig, the more you will discover! Earning coins let’s you select new more powerful tools to dig up our prehistoric past. Each new dig is an opportunity for budding paleontologists to crack rocks, brush away dirt, assemble fossils and uncover new dinosaurs and new dinosaur facts! Each dinosaur discovery is rewarded with interactive scenes packed with learning moments and interesting information. Collect all the creature cards and then come back for more!

Think you know your dinosaurs facts? Test your knowledge with a Prehistoric Quiz, earn more dino coins, and keep digging with even better fossil hunting tools!

We’ll see you at the dig site!

games.name: Spot the Difference Ukiyo-e: Fifty-Three Stations of the Toukaidou
games.summary:
Can you spot the shift?

Ready to slow down and compare every detail?

Enjoy a laid-back spot-the-difference game set in ukiyo-e scenes of post towns and famous views along the road from Edo to Kyoto.

Look closely at two similar prints and search for the one place that has changed. A person’s pose, an item, a building, or a bit of scenery might be the clue.

How to play is simple!
・Compare the two ukiyo-e pictures
・Look for the changed spot
・Select the area you think is different

Take in the beautiful landscapes and travelers while putting your focus and observation skills to work. It is great for a quick break or for taking your time with each picture.

Recommended for players who:
・Like spot-the-difference and visual puzzles
・Are curious about ukiyo-e and Japanese scenery
・Want a calm brain-training game
・Enjoy talking through the answer with family or friends

games.name: The Final Scene
games.summary:
Can you trust your memory?

The picture is covered—but did the key detail stay in your head?

You had 60 seconds. You were sure you noticed everything... until one small part disappears behind the mask.

This is a casual visual memory quiz where you study an image, then answer a 4-choice question based on what you remember. The mood may feel dramatic, but the rules are simple and quick.

How to play:
・Study the image while it is shown
・After part of the image is masked, read the question
・Choose one answer from four options
・When you are correct, check the original image again

Every round is a compact test of attention and recall. Even a tiny detail can decide whether your memory tells the whole story.

Play a quick round whenever you like, and see if you can catch what was hiding in the final scene.

Supports button controls and touch controls.

games.name: The Legend of Heroes II: Prophecy of the Moonlight Witch
games.summary: This role-playing title featuring meticulously detailed characters and an epic coming-of-age story introduces two courageous young heroes who must save a magical world in peril. With the return of the "pet system" and the environments from the original The Legend of Heroes: A Tear of Vermillion, The Legend of Heroes II: Prophecy of the Moonlight Witch offers easy-pick-up-and-play game mechanics and improved enemies that gauge the player's strength before attacking. The game opens with childhood friends Jurio and Chris as they embark on a pilgrimage to five shrines surrounding their village. During their journey, they learn of the dangers of the Raual Wave that threatens to destroy everything in its path. Can Jurio and Chris, with the help of their friends, stop the Raual Wave emanating from Queen Isabella's castle? Will they discover the identity of the mysterious Moonlight Witch who predicted it all? Players can join in the adventure with this elegant turn-based role-playing title developed by the legendary Nihon Falcom. [Namco Bandai]

games.name: The Witch's Bakery
games.summary:
The Witch's Bakery is a cozy Adventure RPG about a joyful witch who opens her bakery in modern Paris. She has one special power: she can see into people's heart and heal emotions through magic!

The story progresses through the days as you earn experience, money, and fame, meet new friends and heal their heart.

For some people, their emotion is locked away so strongly than Lunne needs to go inside their heart to help them. She enters their "Heart Palace", a magical space where emotions and thoughts take shape. Lunne needs to guide the personified Emotion back to the heart.

Inside the Heart Palace, Lunne discovers the person's deepest struggles and finds the key ingredient she needs to make a bread that will heal them!

games.name: WordHive 2
games.summary:
Build words, score points, and master the hive.

Word Hive 2 is a word puzzle game where each puzzle gives you seven letters: six outer letters and one required center letter. Use them to create as many words as possible. Every word must include the center letter.

Letters may be used more than once, and each word must contain at least four letters. Longer words earn more points, while special words that use all seven letters, known as pangrams, award bonus points.

Put your mind to the test with every puzzle, discover new words, expand your vocabulary, and enjoy a rewarding word puzzle experience.

Increase your score to climb the ranks, uncover every hidden word, and become the ultimate word master.

Word Hive 2 uses an American English dictionary.

Features
• Play through 2,000 all-new word puzzle levels
• Discover special words called pangrams by using all seven letters
• Learn new English words and expand your vocabulary as you play
• Compete with players around the world on the online leaderboard
• Resume your last game and continue where you left off
• Play in Handheld Mode, Tabletop Mode, or TV Mode

games.name: Hearthwater
games.summary:
Escape to a peaceful seaside village and discover every hidden corner.

Welcome to Hearthwater, a cozy exploration game where there's no combat, no timers, and no pressure—just a beautiful village waiting to be explored. Wander along sandy beaches, stroll through quiet streets, and venture into forests, hills, and hidden paths as you uncover every location the village has to offer.

Take your time soaking in the relaxing atmosphere while searching for landmarks, secret spots, and scenic viewpoints. Every path leads to something new, encouraging you to explore at your own pace and experience the charm of Hearthwater.

Features
> Explore a peaceful seaside village.
> Discover every unique location and hidden area.
> Relax with a cozy, stress-free exploration experience.
> Immerse yourself in a calm atmosphere.
> Take your time—there are no timers, combat, or pressure.

Every path has a story. Every corner is waiting to be discovered.

games.name: Kero Kero Cowboy
games.summary:
Kero Kero Cowboy is a cartoony western themed retro style platformer!

Explore the frontier as Kero Kero, a cowboy frog on a quest to bring peace and justice to the Wild West. Use your extendable tongue, trusty six-shooter, and wits to conquer the wildest outlaws of the west. Yeehaw!

Face dastardly foes, perilous platforming challenges, and intense shootouts across deserts, mines, mountains, trains, forests, and beyond!

Kero Kero features an array of techniques and abilities to help him on his quest. He can eat enemies, spit them back out, or even brandish a giant revolver to dispatch far-off foes! But be aware, a 6-shooter only has room for 6 bullets, so use them wisely! He can also swim with ease, ride in a giant cowboy boot to stomp enemies, ride rails in a mine cart, and spit hot fire after eating a spicy jalapeño pepper. How to best utilize his abilities in each scenario is up to you, the player!

games.name: Mega City Force
games.summary: The crime is out of control, the streets are not clean. There are criminals and psychopaths everywhere, ready to cut anyone's throat. A corrupt megacorporation squeezes the life out of the citizens, seeking to establish control all over the city. Only the incorruptible police officers of Mega City Police Department stand fast before the crime wave that consumed the city and threatens to overwhelm society. Choose your cop and dive into a deadly battle against the criminals and brutal bosses to unleash the beast of justice in the darkest corners of the city.

games.name: Suncroft
games.summary:
Welcome to Suncroft, a cozy exploration game where every street and hidden corner invites you to slow down and enjoy the journey!

Take your time strolling through the town, discovering hidden paths, relaxing by fountains, and uncovering charming landmarks scattered throughout the world. With no combat, no timers, and no pressure, Suncroft is all about exploring at your own pace and soaking in its warm, welcoming atmosphere.

Features
>Explore a handcrafted sunny town.
>Discover every unique location and hidden area.
>Enjoy a relaxing, stress-free exploration experience.
>Immerse yourself in a warm and peaceful atmosphere.
>No combat, no timers, and no pressure—just exploration

games.name: With Eyes of Ice
games.summary: An atmospheric, dramatic otome-esque visual novel set in Iceland in the 1800s. Follow the kind-hearted heroine, Gréta, as she finds herself caught between the affections of three handsome men who care for her in different ways.

games.name: Colorbound
games.summary: In Colorbound, color is more than just hue. As Anku, an Aymara boy with a unique gift, you’ll harness the power of color to shape the environment itself, uncovering hidden paths to navigate challenging and complex puzzles.

games.name: Horror Prison: Escape
games.summary: You're not alone.

games.name: Apidya' Special
games.summary:
The legendary 1992 Amiga shoot ’em up Apidya is making its long-awaited comeback. 

Developed by the original team, together with a devoted Apidya super-fan-turned-developer, Apidya’ Special is based on a previously abandoned 1990s console port, combining original assets with all-new pixel art, additional authentic sound effects, and remixed music. Legendary composer Chris Hülsbeck contributes an exclusive, completely rearranged soundtrack which has never been released.

Players can experience Apidya’ Special in true widescreen with new parallax effects or switch to the original Amiga 4:3 mode that looks, plays, and sounds exactly like 1992. Optional CRT effects with simulated shadow mask, scan lines, and phosphor bloom recreate the classic display feel.

games.name: Fractured Worlds
games.summary:
Fractured Worlds is a Dark Fantasy Action RPG set in a reality that has been broken into pieces by the ambition of its inhabitants. Now, guided by a mysterious voice, you must explore these broken realms, piece together the past, and confront those responsible for this cataclysmic event.

Journey through unique procedural environments that are fragments of former worlds. Navigate medieval Dungeons, the mystical enchanted Forests, volcanic landscapes, and future industrial Cities. Find memory fragments that reveal the stories of those affected by the cataclysm, helping you understand what happened and mend the broken world.

games.name: 28 Days Train Wreck Survivor
games.summary:
Stranded after a brutal train crash, your survival begins now.

You wake amidst twisted metal and shattered carriages, trapped between steep cliffs and a vast lake. With only your wits and determination, you must explore, gather, and fight to stay alive for 28 days — until rescue arrives.

Every decision counts. Every resource matters. Will you endure?

EXPLORE THE WRECKAGE
Search every train car for supplies, tools, and hidden loot. Some wagons are locked or contain only fragments of the gear you need, forcing you to combine parts and improvise to survive.

MASTER RESOURCE MANAGEMENT
Hunt, fish, forage mushrooms and berries, and collect wood. Keep fires burning, craft essential tools, and make every piece of salvaged material count.

CRAFT & SURVIVE
Build makeshift shelters, repair damaged gear, and create survival equipment from scavenged parts. Creativity and resourcefulness are the keys to lasting 28 days.

FACE THE WILD
The wilderness is dangerous — giant lizards and other predators lurk everywhere. Stay alert, defend yourself, and never underestimate the wildlife.

PLAN FOR THE 28-DAY CHALLENGE
Balance risk and reward. Explore further or stay safe. Every day brings hunger, cold, and new dangers — only careful planning and bold action will see you through.

CROSS-SAVE & CROSS-BUY
Start your struggle on PlayStation®4 and continue seamlessly on PlayStation®5. Your progress and your tools move with you — your fight for survival never has to stop.

Do you have the skill, patience, and grit to survive all 28 days?

games.name: Aggelos 2
games.summary:
Jump into an action-packed 2D retro Metroidvania adventure where reactive combat, smart exploration and powerful polarising abilities collide.

Aggelos 2 is a full evolution of the original, now thrusting the visuals into the 16-bit era. Its transformational twist takes the gameplay to another level, as the world now exists in two overlapping realms: Light and Darkness.

You are an Aggelos - the highest rank among the angels - as the gods face imminent defeat at the hands of the Army of Darkness, you are sent on an epic journey by Balro through Lumen, the domain of the supreme god of light. With Lumen under siege, you must battle through the chaos in both the Light and Dark worlds layered over one another. Both filled with challenging enemies, twisting paths, and thought-provoking puzzles. Shifting between realms is key to your survival and progress.

games.name: Captain Tsubasa 2: World Fighters
games.summary:
The next episode of Tsubasa’s riveting adventure is here! Enjoy the thrill of spectacular soccer actions with 110 playable characters and new sensational super moves. 

CAPTAIN TSUBASA 2: WOLRD FIGHTERS invites fans to follow their journey to victory by creating their own character and joining Tsubasa on his quest. Players will forge new friendships, fight new rivals, and bring the trophy back home.

Action on the field has been significantly enhanced for this new release. New super moves increase the intensity of every part of the game, allowing players to dominate the field when they pass, dribble, tackle or block with their own special techniques.

Even blocking goal shots becomes more tactical with a new system that pits goalkeeper against shooter, letting both players experience and counter jaw dropping super shots and blocks from characters of the original series.

games.name: Ghetto Zombies: Graffiti Squad
games.summary:
Ghetto Zombies is an intense pixel art action shooter where you take control of different heroes from an elite squad to face hordes of zombies and eccentric creatures.

Armed to the teeth with quirky weapons - like ketchup pistols, bubble gum launchers, and water guns - you'll explore a chaotic city, showcase your art with graffiti, defeat challenging bosses, and hunt for the cure to the epidemic!

games.name: Golftacular!
games.summary: Mini-golf turned upside down! Abuse wild items on a variety of challenging golf tours. Shoot, fly, explode, and whatever else you can to get in the hole! It’s golf… barely.

games.name: Horripilant
games.summary:
You awaken. An old, battered knight, lost in the darkest corners of an abandoned dungeon, with no memory of how you got there. The stench of decay permeates the thick air. The walls seem to whisper your name.

A strange tree catches your eye. Barely a sprout, growing in defiance of the dark. The voice demands you hit it. A twig breaks off onto the ground. The first of many.

Distorted moans echo from an empty staircase. Beckoning you. You must go down. It is your purpose...

Encounter bizarre characters, solve cryptic puzzles, and survive the horrors that lurk in every shadow. Will you escape this living nightmare, or will it consume you?

games.name: Inside the Cube
games.summary: Lost between endless rooms.

games.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Baekje Military Museum
games.summary:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone.

There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed. You can also change the drone's flight mode from Normal, Sport, and Eco to any of the 3.

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Baekje Military Museum, Korea with "Real" footage!

games.name: Lou's Lagoon
games.summary:
Launch from the sea and take to the skies! Lou's Lagoon is a cosy open world adventure where you make friends and uncover secrets across a gorgeous archipelago.

Collect, harvest, fish, craft and trade various goods, then deliver them safely to the individual islands in your trusty seaplane. Customise and strengthen your plane over time, overcoming storms, pirates, and magic in order to reach new islanders. Forge new connections and service your community.

Secrets lurk in the corners of every island. While completing deliveries, you'll also unearth treasures and find clues about your wacky uncle Lou.

games.name: Magnetail
games.summary:
Get ready to enter a world of clever inventions, smart challenges, and brilliant solutions in Magnetail. In this charming puzzle adventure, you follow an ingenious inventor mouse who transforms workshops, laboratories, and storage rooms into playgrounds of experimentation and discovery.

Each level presents a new challenge where energy, magnetism, and logic work together. Push energy modules, watch them slide across the environment, and use magnets strategically to redirect trajectories, create barriers, and open unexpected paths. It may seem simple at first, but you will quickly discover that every move can completely change the outcome of the puzzle.

The key is thinking several steps ahead. Where will the module stop? Which magnet should be used first? Which route leaves the path clear for the next move? In Magnetail, every decision matters, and finding the perfect solution is as satisfying as powering up a complex machine for the very first time.

Explore 30 carefully crafted levels spread across busy workshops, experimental laboratories, and storage facilities filled with mechanical challenges. New situations constantly emerge, requiring observation, planning, and creativity to master the rules of magnetism and turn obstacles into opportunities.

With charming visuals, accessible controls, and puzzles that reward intelligence and experimentation, Magnetail delivers a relaxing, engaging, and highly rewarding experience. It is the kind of game that makes you stop, study the room for a moment, and then smile when the perfect solution finally clicks into place.

Align the modules, master the magnets, and prove that no invention is too complex for a brilliant mind.

games.name: Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots - Master Collection Version
games.summary:
Solid Snake's Final Mission
The extreme tension of infiltrating without being detected.
Metal Gear series, the pinnacle of “stealth action” Immerse yourself in the Metal Gear series, the pinnacle of “stealth action” where you can infiltrate and elude your enemies to complete missions.

The game takes place five years after the Big Shell incident in METAL GEAR SOLID 2: Sons of Liberty, in a world where war has become a business.
To stop Liquid Ocelot's uprising, Solid Snake throws himself into his final battle.
The battle against Liquid and the Patriots draws to a close, and the mysteries woven throughout the series are now revealed!

【STORY】
THE TRANSFORMATION OF WAR INTO BUSINESS.
In an era where PMCs (private military companies) have risen to the top, war has become a business and the driving force behind the world economy.

Controlling the top five PMCs from behind the scenes is Liquid Ocelot, who fanning the flames of war even further, plans an insurrection with the goal of creating a world where warriors can lead fulfilling lives—a goal shared by none other than Big Boss.

Under the theme of “Sense” watch as the final battle of the man with Big Boss’s genes, Solid Snake, unfolds.

games.name: Metal Gear Solid: Master Collection Vol. 2
games.summary:
The extreme tension of infiltrating without being detected.
Metal Gear series, the pinnacle of “stealth action” Immerse yourself in the Metal Gear series, the pinnacle of “stealth action” where you can infiltrate and elude your enemies to complete missions.
This collection is the second installment of the definitive Metal Gear Master Collection.

Vol. 2 includes Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots and Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker (HD Collection version).

Each game includes a Screenplay Book containing the text from the respective title, plus a Master Book offering detailed insights into the story and characters.

Also, as purchase bonuses for the collection edition, it includes METAL GEAR Ghost Babel—the series first title for handheld consoles, released in 2000—and Metal Gear Solid: Digital Soundtrack Vol.2, featuring numerous iconic tracks that enhanced Snake's missions, ranging from BGM used in the games to vocal songs.

[Game List]
Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots
Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker (HD Collection version)
Metal Gear: Ghost Babel
*Versions for other regions of Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots can be downloaded separately from the store.
*Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker (HD Collection version) supports online play for up to 6 players.

games.name: Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker - Master Collection Version
games.summary:
In 1964, Naked Snake, who saved the world from the threat of all-out nuclear war between the United States and the Soviet Union, was hailed as a true hero and bestowed the title "BIGBOSS." However, after the award ceremony, Snake disappeared...

Ten years later, Snake, who had organized his own army in Colombia, South America, is visited by a visitor from Costa Rica, a country without an army.

Costa Rica, a region of Latin America that holds the key to the East-West power balance since the Cuban Missile Crisis, has miraculously maintained peace. However, mysterious armed groups have been making suspicious moves across the country. 

They ask Snake to investigate and eliminate the group. 

Snake hesitates to accept the request, but the tape they bring contains the voice of The Boss, who was supposed to be dead.

games.name: The Immortal John Triptych
games.summary:
Immortal John is dying. A holy war has ended in chaos. Sin itself demands reckoning. Three interconnected tales unfold across a world built from Renaissance paintings and Classical music, where the ridiculous and the profound collide. 

Help locals with their daily tasks, only to find the Devil lurking in the shadows. Chase a tyrant across kingdoms while assisting inept magicians and negotiating with God Almighty. Navigate sin, death, judgement, heaven and hell, all topped with a cherry of gleeful flippancy. 

From quiet countryside kindness spiraling into madness, to holy vengeance wrapped in absurdity, to cosmic philosophy delivered with a wink and a nudge, The Immortal John Triptych proves that the most intelligent thing you can do is embrace the utterly ridiculous.

games.name: Therian Crush: Wild Animal Boys
games.summary:
These guys are wild by nature. 
Get close, earn their trust, and unlock what they don't show just anyone.

games.name: Delivery Simulator
games.summary:
Parcels don’t deliver themselves, and the city won’t make things easy for you. Take the wheel and face the intense daily grind of a delivery driver, navigating busy streets, tight shortcuts, and surprises at every corner. Collect orders, load the cargo, and plan the best route to arrive on time.

Unlock achievements by completing special objectives, beating the clock without crashing your car, and maintaining delivery streaks with no delays. More challenges mean more reasons to improve with every run!

The goal is simple: deliver as much as possible, earn rewards, buy a variety of insane vehicles, and upgrade your operation to become a true reference in the city. Because here, every second counts and every delivery makes a difference!

games.name: Frogborne: New Lands
games.summary: A colorful adventure awaits!

games.name: Toaplan Arcade Garage: Flying Fire Shark
games.summary: The Shark series, created by legendary Japanese studio Toaplan, is a landmark shoot ’em up series. Flying Shark (1987), which was well received for its simple rules and exquisitely tuned difficulty level, had a tremendous impact on vertical scrolling shoot ’em up games. The sequel Fire Shark (1989), with its screen-filling weaponry, set arcades ablaze with its destructive carnage!

games.name: Tenshi no Uta: The Angel Verse Collection
games.summary:
A classic RPG revived with great music.

The "Tenshi no Uta" series is one of the masterpieces of PC Engine RPGs, with a rare theme of Celtic mythology and the theme of love between men and women. The majestic BGM, which matches the world view that allows you to empathize with the visual scenes and story, is a must-listen masterpiece.

In addition to the story, there are many elements to keep you engaged, such as searching for rare weapons for each character, and the gameplay is also attractive, so players will not get bored.

games.name: Angeline Era
games.summary:
Every level is hidden in plain sight in this nonlinear 3D Action-Adventure game! Travel a vast country's unmarked overworld in search of the next challenging fight, humorous encounter, or mysterious landscape. YOU decide what you discover next in this world of Fae, Humans and Angels!

The Angel's mothership, Throne, lays dormant behind a fierce storm. To reach it, unlock its secrets, and usher in the future, you must explore the land of Era and survive its trap-filled ruins, primordial forests, treacherous mountains, mines, and more! Overcome intense battles and hilarious hazards in this tale of betrayal, haunting lore, and fruitless yearning.

games.name: Super Woden: Rally Edge
games.summary:
The spin-off of the acclaimed Super Woden saga, blending classic arcade essence with great depth and a genuine love for car culture.

With a unique personality, Rally Edge takes you back to an era where fun goes beyond realism.

games.name: AereA
games.summary:
AereA is a music themed Action RPG in which you play as one of Great Maestro Guido's disciples and explore Aezir; a floating island that was broken into pieces. Your mission is to find and return the nine primordial instruments to restore balance and peace to the world.

You have to find your way through all parts of the scattered islands; complete quests, solve puzzles, defeat bosses and discover the truth behind the islands. Will you be able to return the nine primordial instruments?

Play as Wolff the Harp-Archer, Jacques the Cello-Knight, Jules the Lute-Mage, Claude the Trumpet-Gunner, or team up with your friends in local co-op. Collect Music Sheets to learn new skills and customize your weapons to your play style.

games.name: Hashire Hebereke: EX
games.summary:
Hashire HEBEREKE: EX is a modern remake of the 1994 Super Famicom game Hashire Hebereke by SUNSOFT.

Players can choose from a cast of quirky and adorable characters to race through item-filled, obstacle-packed courses. Local multiplayer supports up to four players, while online multiplayer supports up to eight players, ensuring fun and frantic competition.

games.name: Horse Spirit Valley 2
games.summary: Ride free through a living valley of meadows, forests, frost and dusk. Tame wild horses, style them in the Horse Boutique, collect gems, and explore five beautiful worlds in Horse Spirit Valley 2.

games.name: Jigsaw Puzzle: Frog
games.summary: Ribbit!

games.name: Marsupilami 2 - Salsa Palombia
games.summary: A strange melody has swept across Palombia… and suddenly every animal starts dancing wildly, throwing the jungle into total chaos! Behind this rhythmic madness lurks the Mummy Queen, back from the Underworld with her crew to deliver a cursed concert with devastating effects. To restore peace to the jungle, take control of the three young Marsus, each with their own signature ability. Twister shoots through the air with a turbo glide, Hope leaps forward with an energetic spinning jump, and Punch bounces with powerful force to knock aside anything in his path! Switch instantly from one Marsu to another to unleash their powers and chain together stylish moves. And for even more fun, share the adventure with a friend thanks to local co‑op mode! From the Jungle to the City, from Snowy Mountains to the mysterious Underworld…explore four enchanting worlds packed with surprises, challenges, and unique gameplay mechanics. Beyond the main adventure, take on the Flow Mode, a speed-focused challenge where you must complete a series of trials without dying to prove your skills! And for even more fun, challenge your friends in competitive dojos.

games.name: Pardon My French Toast
games.summary: Pardon My French Toast is a 3D platformer starring a slice of toast who covers himself in sweet spreads to get fun abilities.

games.name: SpeedRunners 2: King of Speed
games.summary:
SpeedRunners 2: King of Speed is a fast-paced competitive platformer and a sequel to one of the most beloved indie games of the 2010s. Pick a character of your choice from a vibrant cast of eccentric superheroes, both returning and new, and face off against your rivals in frenetic running races for up to 8 players per lobby, locally or online.

The original multiplayer gameplay formula of SpeedRunners is timeless, unofficially dubbed as the ‘Mario Kart of 2D platformers’. With the sequel, our goal is to carefully bring this unique ‘SpeedRunners feel’ into the new era without compromising on the depth and fluidity of the movement system while still keeping it easy to grasp. On top of that, King of Speed introduces vibrant high-definition graphics and improved netcode.

games.name: Superstar Strategy
games.summary:
Outfight and outwit your enemies in this turn-based tactics game. Use each unit's unique abilities and the terrain around you to your advantage to thwart your opponent's plans and reign supreme!

Push, pull, teleport, and displace your enemies onto traps to deal additional damage and apply status effects between rounds. If you are able to escape the trap before the new round starts, you can cheat fate!

With 14 different unit roles to choose from, you can create your own unique combinations to build your own personal army! Experiment with different units to find synergies and force multipliers to improve your chances of victory.

games.name: Asdivine Knot
games.summary:
A young cleric named Verselio once devoted his life to serving the deity Treises - until the truth shattered everything he believed. 

When the divine is revealed to be a lie, faith turns into fury, and a journey of rebellion begins. Joined by a mysterious maiden, a disciplined vigilante chief, and a self-proclaimed deity, Verselio sets out across a vast fantasy world in search of answers. As their paths intertwine, each carries their own burdens, beliefs, and secrets, in a story of betrayal, redemption, and the meaning of faith in a deityless world.

Asdivine Knot is a classic turn-based JRPG that blends strategic command battles with modern systems and deep customization. Master the shared Nexus Gauge to control the flow of combat, unleash powerful Nexus Skills, and summon devastating entities to turn the tide. Explore a wide world with your fully customizable airship, craft and upgrade equipment using collected materials, and shape your adventure with side quests, crew recruitment, fishing, and puzzle dungeons. 

Packed with rich content and designed for a complete single-player experience, this is a must-play fantasy RPG for fans of traditional Japanese role-playing games.

games.name: Isle of Reveries
games.summary: Make a pilgrimage skybound to the Isle of Reveries, where any wish can be granted. Conquer mysterious dungeons, solve puzzles, and explore a vast overworld in this retro-inspired adventure.

games.name: Culdcept The First Saturn Tribute
games.summary:
The pinnacle of board game and card game fusion is back. 

The Culdcept series has captivated players worldwide. Now, the original masterpiece returns, enhanced with convenient new features. 
Build your deck from over 300 types of cards and witness the dawn of a new battle among Cepter. 

> The "Book" of the Gods moves the world.
On the continent of Bablashca, where the chief god Culdra once clashed with the neutral god Baltias, humanity -- Culdra’s final creation—had long flourished.

However, the world fell into chaos when stone tablets discovered across the land were revealed to be fragments of "Culdcept" -- the Book of Creation and Destruction.

Driven by the mythical prophecy that "he who commands the Culdcept shall gain infinite power," Cepter began to fight one another over the scattered fragments.

As the ravages of war spread, a lone youth finally rises and sets out on a long, epic journey. 

> A Battle of Offense and Defense for Territory
Players become "Cepter" who wield cards, heading into battle with a self-constructed 50-card "Book" (deck).

Move across the map guided by the roll of the dice and summon creatures using cards on the spaces where you land. Any land where you place a creature becomes your territory.

By using Spell Cards, you can manipulate dice rolls, support your creatures, or sabotage your rivals.

The first Cepter to collect the target amount of Magic Power and return to the Castle (the starting point) is declared the winner.

After a match, you will receive a random set of cards based on your ranking. Incorporate these new cards into your Book and refine your tactics for the next battle. 

> Incandescent Battles Featuring 180 Types of Creatures
When you land on another player's territory, you must pay Magic Power as a toll. However, by summoning a creature and winning a battle, you can claim that territory as your own.

In battle, the key to victory lies not only in a creature's stats and special abilities but also in Item Card effects and support bonuses from the land or allies.

Seize territories and increase your Magic Power to gain the upper hand in the game. 

> Equipped with New Features for a Smoother Gameplay Experience
[Rewind] Rewind the game to any point someone passed a Checkpoint at a Fort or the Castle.

[Quick Save & Load] Enables you to save and load at any time, independent of the main game's standard save function.

[Bonus Pack] Increases the number of reward cards received at the end of a match. This can be toggled ON/OFF in the options menu.

[Reveal Hands] This feature allows you to constantly display both your own and your opponent's hand on-screen—information that was only visible at specific times in the original version. It can be toggled ON/OFF, and the display size adjusts automatically according to the game's screen layout.

[Language Switching] You can play the game in either Japanese or English.

Note: Save data is not shared between languages. Separate save files will be created for Japanese and English.

games.name: Barbarian Saga: The Beastmaster
games.summary:
After the brief peace that followed the wars of the portals that devastated the country, new winds of war threaten its inhabitants when the new king of Imperia together with the Sacred Kingdom have started a war against non-humans, using the services of one of the Last Wizards of Arborea: Trece XIII and their generals, it is the moment of the prophecy, a chosen one will unite Men and beasts to bring peace.

A classic hand-drawn 2D Metroidvania action game. Use your Beastmaster skills to unleash your inner beast, fight with your heart-devouring sword and end the threat to Arborea.

games.name: Touhou Koumakyou: New Classic - The Embodiment of Scarlet Devil
games.summary: Dodge the barrage, defeat enemies, and brave the Scarlet Mist incident.The Embodiment of Scarlet Devil returns with fresh music and graphics.You control the shrine maiden Reimu and the magician Marisa, dodge barrages and shoot at enemies.The background music features complete rearrangements by ZUN.

games.name: Circuit Flow
games.summary: Route the signal. Power the board.

games.name: FOUNTAINS
games.summary:
The Fountain of Youth was hidden away. Nonetheless, it is fated that the malevolent Usurper shall slay the Ageless and unearth it once more.

FOUNTAINS is an action-RPG about fighting your way through a maze-like interconnected world. You'll take the role of a hooded stranger, recently imprisoned by a tyrannical regime.

Will you escape and uncover the mysteries of this war-torn empire?

games.name: Hazard Pay
games.summary:
The job is simple: destroy evidence. Leave no trace. Don’t die in the process.

Hazard Pay is a pixel-art block-pushing puzzler set in a crumbling dystopian world. You’ll navigate alone through abandoned and contaminated facilities, dodging environmental hazards while completing your employer’s checklist with calculated efficiency.

games.name: Woodo
games.summary:
Woodo is a cozy 3D puzzle game based on simple diorama assembly mechanics with a beautiful visual style. 

The game is a reminiscence of childhood memories playing with a tiny wooden constructor, immersing players in a peaceful, safe and creative world.

games.name: MONOWAVE
games.summary:
In MONOWAVE, embark on an exploratory adventure shaped by emotion, atmosphere and discovery. Play as Mono, a newborn Guardian tasked with restoring balance to a broken world by reuniting the four Emotions: Anger, Anxiety, Happiness and Sorrow. As the guardian spirit of the Emotions, Mono can use emotional powers to interact with the eccentric inhabitants of each world, soothe four rampaging Emotions, and help them regain their balance before the world unravels any further.

Guide Mono through a series of evocative worlds, using observation and emotional awareness to overcome environmental challenges and connect with the world around them. Through thoughtful platforming, puzzle-driven progression and empathetic encounters with characters, uncover a heartfelt story that explores the complicated but meaningful ways different emotions manifest in our lives.

Players can experience MONOWAVE’s first chapter on Steam, offering roughly one hour of gameplay. Set in World 1, “The Panic Jungle,” a realm consumed by anxiety, players will learn MONOWAVE’s core emotion-based mechanics and face the first boss encounter, offering a hands-on introduction to the game’s heartfelt world ahead of its September 16th launch.

games.name: Roman Sands RE:Build
games.summary:
Washed up on the shores of a timeless luxury retreat, you find yourself acquainted with its unhinged inhabitants. They await the day that the Sun will swallow the world. You are obligated to serve their whims. 

There's more to this place than meets the eye. Can you uncover your exit?

Roman Sands RE:Build is a delirium-charged journey into apocalypse which collides through visual novel, adventure, puzzle solving, horror, and survival simulation.

games.name: Mr. Sleepy Man
games.summary: Mr. Sleepy Man is up way past his bedtime and out of control! Make a mess of everything you find and turn Bedtime Town against you! This sandbox adventure is filled with comical hijinks, outrageous characters, and platforming action!

games.name: Sniper Dan
games.summary:
Sniper Dan is a ridiculous, family-friendly 3D Hidden Object game with a big twist. Use a high-powered sniper rifle to solve low-stakes problems. Scope the scene, spot the problem, and shoot the solution. No violence. Just wholesome chaos and good intentions!

You’re not hunting enemies. You’re hunting problems. Fixing rusty taps, machines behaving badly and even stop a thieving Pelican. Travel far and wide across lively 3D locations packed with visual jokes and silly situations as you help those in need. 

Can Dan and his trusty tool get the job done?

games.name: Trine 6: Together in Time
games.summary:
Adventures are better together... even when they don’t start that way.

In a distant corner of the Kingdom, two enterprising young souls, Moira and Adrius, find themselves in over their heads when a heist goes wrong, accidentally binding their fate to that of the realm’s greatest heroes.

Now together with Amadeus, Zoya, and Pontius, the unlikely party must journey across perilous fantasy landscapes and overcome mounting challenges to restore a powerful magic gone awry before a dangerous warlock closes in to reclaim what is his.

Trine 6: Together in Time is a co-op puzzle platformer for 1-4 players. Wit, timing, and teamwork collide as you solve perplexing puzzles, engage cunning creatures, and traverse perilous paths in the next adventure through Trine’s iconic fantasy world.

games.name: Tristia: Chronicles
games.summary:
Tristia: Legacy and Tristia: Restore are together in one updated collection! 

The beautiful city of Tristia, nicknamed the "Jewel of the Sea," has bustled with maritime trade until recent dragon attacks stripped the city of its charm, and the people are resigned to its state of decay. Crafter-inventor Nanoca has been challenged to restore the city within a year. Will Tristia regain its former vibrancy or will it remain in disrepair? Everything depends on your hard work.

Tristia: Restore takes place alongside Tristia: Legacy, but focuses on the day-to-day running of Nanoca’s shop. She has some major crafting projects to complete, but while she works to finish them, a constant barrage of requests pour in. Use minigames to gather your materials, choose the right equipment, and deliver completed items to the townsfolk. Can you accomplish everything before time runs out?
